paragraphs.source_en: Fortune is unpredictable: Katō Kiyomasa, the leading advocate of war who had been recalled from Korea by Hideyoshi after falling victim to slander, used the great Fushimi earthquake as an opportunity to return to prominence. Overcoming every objection, he finally prevailed in his demand that they fight to the bitter end. Hideyoshi's body was no longer capable of commanding in the field. In the past, however, he had merely blustered; this time he showed no intention whatsoever of stopping.
